SAMPLE LETTER FOR DEMONSTRATION. NOT A REAL NOTICE.

Sunshine Health
Florida Medicaid Managed Medical Assistance
Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination

Date: October 14, 2026
Member: J. Sample (age 9)
Member ID: 00000000-SAMPLE
Provider: Sample Home Nursing LLC

This letter is about the request for private duty nursing, 8 hours per day, service code T1000, for dates of service September 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026. The amount billed was $4,320.00.

We have denied this request. Reason: Services exceed the authorized amount. The plan approved fewer hours than were billed for this period.

You have the right to appeal this decision. Your appeal must be received within 60 days of the date of this letter, by December 13, 2026. You may ask for a copy of the rule we used and the records we reviewed at no cost.

This is a synthetic sample written for a software demonstration. It does not describe a real member, provider, or claim.

findings.question: Is private duty nursing covered by Florida Medicaid for children under 21?
findings.answer: Yes, Florida Medicaid covers Private Duty Nursing Services in the family home or other community-based setting for enrollees under age 21, and services exceeding the policy or fee schedule may be approved if medically necessary. It does not cover private duty nursing by an independent RN or LPN who is a related provider, legal guardian, or caretaker relative, and does not cover private duty nursing and family home health aide services provided concurrently.

citations.title: SMMC Model Health Plan Contract, Exhibit II-A: Managed Medical Assistance (MMA) Program
citations.quote: The Managed Care Plan shall implement case management processes for enrollees under the age of twenty–one (21) years who are receiving services in a Skilled Nursing Facility, receiving Private Duty Nursing Services in their family home or other community– based setting, receiving Prescribed Pediatric Extended Care (PPEC) services, and receiving medical foster care services.

citations.title: Florida Medicaid Private Duty Nursing and Family Home Health Aide Services Coverage Policy (Rule 59G-4.261)
citations.quote: As such, services for recipients under the age of 21 years exceeding the coverage described within this policy or the associated fee schedule may be approved, if medically necessary.

citations.title: Florida Medicaid Private Duty Nursing and Family Home Health Aide Services Coverage Policy (Rule 59G-4.261)
citations.quote: Florida Medicaid does not cover the following: • Private duty nursing services provided by an independent RN or LPN when the provider is a related provider, legal guardian, or caretaker relative • Private duty nursing services and family home health aide services provided concurrently

findings.question: What hour or daily limits does Florida Medicaid set for private duty nursing for children under 21?
findings.answer: Florida Medicaid covers up to 40 hours per week for PDN services per related provider, legal guardian, or caretaker relative employed by a home health agency. For recipients under age 21, services exceeding the coverage described in the policy or fee schedule may be approved if medically necessary.

citations.title: Florida Medicaid Private Duty Nursing and Family Home Health Aide Services Coverage Policy (Rule 59G-4.261)
citations.quote: Florida Medicaid covers an enrolled home health agency provider for up to 40 hours per week for PDN services per related provider, legal guardian, or caretaker relative, with a valid RN or LPN license in the state of Florida and who is employed by the home health agency.

citations.title: Florida Medicaid Private Duty Nursing and Family Home Health Aide Services Coverage Policy (Rule 59G-4.261)
citations.quote: As such, services for recipients under the age of 21 years exceeding the coverage described within this policy or the associated fee schedule may be approved, if medically necessary.
